_governance.hashScope: content of locally committed files (not upstream source files)
_governance.pinnedShaSemantics: SHAs recorded during governance backfill 2026-08-05 are upstream HEAD at that date, not original install-time SHAs (which were not recorded). Treat as reference snapshots only. For all future vendoring, record the exact SHA at install time.
_governance.schemaChanges: v1→v2: removed computedHash (was inconsistently computed against source files for hyperframes suite) and skillPath (was upstream source path, not local committed path). Replaced with committedFiles (local path → SHA-256 of committed content), sourceUrl, license, pinnedSha, localModifications, updateProcedure.

skill-only: 1. Fetch upstream SKILL.md at the new target SHA.
2. Diff against the locally committed file.
3. Apply compatible upstream changes; preserve intentional local modifications.
4. Compute new SHA-256 of the updated local file.
5. Update pinnedSha, pinnedShaNote, and the sha256 value in committedFiles.
skill-with-references: 1. Fetch upstream SKILL.md and all files under references/ at the new target SHA.
2. Diff each file against its locally committed version.
3. Apply compatible changes; preserve intentional modifications.
4. Compute SHA-256 for each updated local file.
5. Update pinnedSha, pinnedShaNote, and all entries in committedFiles.
